description: Superfund: Retrieve a site by exact SEMS site ID from epa_superfund_search_sites, with all recorded contaminant associations and their media, operable units, and EPA actions. Repeated chemicals in different contexts and duplicate source rows are retained. An existing site without contaminant records returns an empty array. Associations do not establish current exposure, concentrations, or current risk. Site and contaminant requests share a 50-second deadline.

site_id.description: SEMS siteId from epa_superfund_search_sites; preserve leading zeros

name: epa_superfund_get_site

contaminants.description: Every SEMS contaminant association for the site; empty when none are recorded

items.description: One contaminant association; repeated chemicals and source rows are retained

action.description: EPA action associated with the contaminant

medium.description: Environmental medium associated with the action

operableUnit.description: Operable unit identifier, preserving leading zeros

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `site_not_found`: No SEMS site matches the exact ID. `unmatchable_filter`: site_id holds a character EPA's DMAP service cannot match exactly. `filter_too_long`: site_id makes a request longer than EPA's DMAP service accepts. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

site.description: Superfund site record with source status and assessment metadata

archivedInd.description: Raw SEMS archive indicator, such as Y or N

epaId.description: EPA site identifier distinct from the SEMS site ID

federalFacilityInd.description: Raw SEMS federal facility indicator, such as Y or N

nonNplStatusName.description: Non-NPL assessment label reported by SEMS; not cleanup progress

nplStatus.description: Raw NPL code: F=final, A=part of an NPL site, N=not listed, P=proposed, D=deleted, R=removed, W=withdrawn

nplStatusName.description: NPL status label reported by SEMS

title: Get Superfund Site
